collection.title: H-Files - National Security Review (NSR) Files
collection.methodology: Every file unit was enumerated from the complete NARA Catalog series hierarchy. Catalog coverage dates control the working chronology. NARA extracted text supplies high-level and economic-policy review signals for every online PDF. Routing reflects manual review of every title, full OCR transcript, opening provenance marker, and withdrawal-sheet description. Marker status requires the opening OCR segment to name the record group, office, series, subseries, and folder; one handwritten withdrawal-sheet correction and two marker-to-Catalog Folder ID mismatches are retained explicitly.
